name: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation
blurb: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC) is an investment holding company that engages in the manufacture, testing, and sale of integrated circuit wafers and compound semiconductors. It serves customers in the United States, China, and Eurasia, offering foundry services, design and IP support, and photomask manufacturing. As one of the leading semiconductor foundries globally, SMIC plays a critical role in the semiconductor supply chain, particularly in China. The company has a market capitalization of approximately HKD 733 billion and employs nearly 20,000 people.
recent: In the past 30 days, SMIC's stock price has risen significantly, trading around HKD 77.70 as of May 7, 2026, up 3.81% on the day. The stock has a 52-week range of HKD 38.65 to HKD 93.50, with a year-to-date gain of about 65.5%. Upcoming earnings are scheduled for May 14, 2026, and analysts have raised price targets, with BOCI lifting its target to HKD 83.6.
